Helsinki-NLP / OPUS-MT / Tatoeba Translation Challenge
Japanese (jpn) to Russian (rus), opus-2021-02-18.zip, transformer-align.

Original publisher and model:
https://github.com/Helsinki-NLP/Tatoeba-Challenge/tree/master/models/jpn-rus
https://object.pouta.csc.fi/Tatoeba-MT-models/jpn-rus/opus-2021-02-18.zip

4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), retained beside the installed model and in
OPUS-MT-ja-ru-LICENSE.txt. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
The different license tag on a Hugging Face publication is not substituted
for the license included in this archive.

Changes in QuietSelection: weights converted from Marian to CTranslate2
int8; preprocessing implemented in Python, with fullwidth digit 1 preserved
as a digit instead of the quotation mark in the original preprocessing script.
Separate original source and target SentencePiece models are retained.
No endorsement by the original publisher is implied.
